svg.title: ASAP gate schedules of a 4-qubit GHZ circuit
svg.desc: The same GHZ circuit compiled and scheduled by QPUTwin for a superconducting and a trapped-ion twin: gate boxes use the calibrated durations, hatched spans are idle windows in which the noise model applies relaxation, and read-out is aligned at the end.
svg.text: prx 40 ns · cz 60 ns · read-out 1500 ns
u1q 10 µs · zzmax 100 µs · read-out 150 µs
